preloadPackagingDefect.rootCause: The desktop copies src/preload.cjs into the package while preload.ts only types the surface; the bearer support existed only in preload.ts, so the packaged renderer could not authenticate to the local control plane.
preloadPackagingDefect.priorCodexFix: f46d4fa added the token to preload.cjs via process.argv; 29893a4 made main-process control calls send the bearer.
preloadPackagingDefect.r1Resolution: 4f0499a removed the bearer from BOTH preloads entirely: main attaches X-CodeForge-Control-Token via session.webRequest.onBeforeSendHeaders only for requests from the primary window's top-level document at the app's own URL (control-plane-trust.ts). The renderer never holds the secret; the SSE query-string fallback was removed; will-navigate/window.open no longer admit arbitrary file: URLs.
